title: the crew are agents, not pull requests
acceptance: a crewman is an agent that is working, not a task and not a pull request
the crew comes from the actors in the event log, derived by the server
an agent's bubble says which task it is on, and the roster says the same
two agents on two tasks are two crewmen; one agent that has moved between tasks is one
github is not an agent and is never aboard
the ship's rate follows the number of agents, which is the concurrency, not the backlog
the captain is not crew: he is drawn beside the cards, from the same pending deck the cards come from, and nothing else derives him
an agent that has finished its run is not aboard, whatever became of the task
a run says when it ends, on every exit path including the ones that give up
no script names a signal alongside EXIT in one trap: the handler runs and execution continues, and kill stops working
a suite that prints command-not-found cannot report green: the gate reads what the run said
